objective.title: OBJECTIVE
objective.description: Be the richest player at the end of the game by buying properties and collecting rent.

turn.title: TURN
turn.description: Roll the dice and move your token. Buy free properties or pay rent if they have an owner.

properties.title: PROPERTIES
properties.description: Buy all properties of a color to build houses and hotels.

cards.title: CARDS
cards.description: Land on Chance or Community Chest to receive cards with special effects.

jail.title: JAIL
jail.description: Go to jail if you roll doubles 3 times or land on the space. Pay or roll doubles to get out.

bankruptcy.title: BANKRUPTCY
bankruptcy.description: If you can't pay, sell properties. With nothing to sell, you're eliminated.

errors.invalidPlayers: All players must have a name
